gold.description: Path traversal vulnerability: the `filename` URL parameter is passed directly to `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename)` on line 22 without sanitizing path traversal sequences. An attacker can supply `../../../etc/passwd` to read arbitrary files outside the uploads directory. Validate that the resolved path starts with UPLOAD_DIR using `os.path.realpath()` or use Flask's `safe_join()` utility.

candidate.title: Path traversal — user-controlled path joined to UPLOAD_DIR with no containment check
candidate.description: The route uses the `<path:filename>` converter, allowing `filename` to contain `/` and `..` segments. os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename) resolves outside the uploads directory without containment checks; any authenticated user can read arbitrary files (secrets, source, keys) at web process privileges via paths like `../../etc/passwd` or `../../.env`.
